title: Aldous–Diaconis universality of cutoff conjecture for random Cayley graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a group, let $k$ satisfy $k \gg \log |G|$ and $\log k \ll \log |G|$, and let $\mathcal{G}_k$ be the Cayley graph of $G$ generated by $k$ independently and uniformly chosen random elements of $G$. **Aldous and Diaconis's universality of cutoff conjecture.** The random walk on $\mathcal{G}_k$ exhibits cutoff with high probability. This conjecture concerns the universality of the cutoff phenomenon for random walks on random Cayley graphs. The supplied context does not state whether it has been resolved.
source_name: Jonathan Hermon and Xiangying Huang, “Cutoff for random Cayley graphs of nilpotent groups”, arXiv:2403.12355 (2024).
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2021–2024). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2102.02809](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.02809).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.12355

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2024).
